summary: Frontend-only parallax regression testing passed on the public preview URL for desktop and mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public preview at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Desktop wheel scrolling changed all three parallax layer transforms at distinct rates and faded the bottom indicator; Explore CTA reached #work. Mobile menu and #contact navigation worked, document width equaled viewport, section reveal became visible, and no console errors occurred.
rca of the issue: No application issue reproduced. No APIs were mocked. Frontend-only scope; backend was intentionally skipped.
